gen-eater-gf-sofia-sans: Eater brings a dark, aggressive bite, its thin strokes drifting beside moderately weighty stems with wide gaps between letters. And Sofia Sans follows with rounded, open-sided letters at a single line width, so a longer passage moves along smoothly.
gen-flavors-gf-sen: Sen reads modern and tall, each lowercase letter traced by a line of constant weight with curves that stop before turning inward. Flavors is the showman, its diagonals as hefty as its stems, while Sen does the quiet work of keeping text clear.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Expressive and bold, Autour One draws every round letter with a clear channel leading in and no shift between thin and thick. But Schibsted Grotesk is the real draw, its tall-bowled e and a staying approachable with terminals that never close in.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-sintony: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes, as if with a marker tip. Sintony settles underneath with a chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves that never clog, so a longer passage reads without a snag.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-onest: Onest keeps short ascenders above big bowls, its line drawn with a ruler-and-compass steadiness and no ink pooling in the curves. Goldman does best at being wide and commanding, with round forms like open parentheses, while Onest does best at approachable, contemporary text.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Futuristic and tech to the core, Audiowide sets its glyphs like tiles with wide grout lines and no thick-thin shift. Noto Sans Tai Viet follows at a smaller size, perhaps.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display shows a pronounced x-height and letters that never seem to pinch shut above everything else. Anek Gurmukhi answers with open counters and generous curves.
gen-eater-gf-stack-sans-headline: Stack Sans Headline reads crisp even at tiny sizes, with wide gaps and a deep middle band on a ballpoint-like monoline skeleton. Eater sits against it with soft-pencil thick-thin shifts, dark and aggressive, so a longer passage feels like a growl handing off to a plain sans.
gen-flavors-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condensed: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors piles up a towering x-height with diagonals as hefty as its stems. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed keeps a stencil-cut constant weight, quietly.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-sono: A single-depth cut, like an engraver's, runs through Autour One, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. And Sono follows as a plain sans with wide default spacing and a tall lowercase, so a longer passage moves along without crowding.
